candidate.rollback: Set ZERO_SLOP_MODE=classic or leave it unset.

structured_contextual_shadow.limits: Two blind LLM editorial raters reviewed the same small clustered panel in opposite directions. This measures cross-rater reproducibility, not independent human field accuracy; borderline labels abstain.

reason_labelled_retrieval.limits: Retrieval needs repeated, source-bound edits from a real writer before a field-quality lift can be estimated. It remains advisory and cannot bypass fidelity or safety gates.

blind_evaluation_lane.gain: Adds an independently split release-research lane and exposes unresolved labels; it does not change a draft or score.

interleaved_local_performance.environment: Darwin arm64, Python 3.9.6; four alternating runs per version on the same machine
interleaved_local_performance.verdict: No material classic-path regression in this noisy local sample. Contextual packet preparation and validation remain separate from host-model latency.

production_verdict.reason: Classic scoring is bit-for-bit unchanged, the added local paths are bounded and fail closed, and the contextual lane improved blind cross-rater agreement. The evidence is not yet strong enough to enable assisted mode globally.
production_verdict.promotion_requirement: Promote assisted mode only after an independently human-labelled, source-grouped field set shows a material quality gain without fidelity, subgroup, latency, or cost regression.
